Name: Lnh's Yun Jian Falls Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]一个新农场，坐落在山顶之上，溪流瀑布贯穿全图。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]拥有多个温泉入口，供你恢复体力。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]农场内有多个矿车，方便快速到达各个区域。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]所有地块都可以种植。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]默认替换标准农场。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]A new farm located on the mountaintop, with streams and waterfalls running through the entire map.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]Having multiple hot spring entrances for you to recover your energy.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]There are multiple mine carts on the farm, making it easy to quickly reach various areas.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]All plots can be planted.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]Default replacement of standard farm.[/color][/size][/center]
